questions.q: The block shifts left. Tap where the right ala waits.
options: Inside the block, near the ball
Wide, beyond the block's far edge
questions.explain: Yes. Outside the far edge, the right ala is ready for the switch later.
choiceExplanations: Inside the block, the defenders can mark you easily. Nobody is left to switch to.
The pivot already holds that space. Two players there close together are easy to mark.
Yes. Outside the far edge, the right ala is ready for the switch later.

questions.q: How do we move the block, then switch? Put the steps in order.
options: Draw the block to the left
Pass back to the deeper fixo
Fixo switches to the right ala
Right ala receives outside the block
questions.explain: Right. Pull the block one way, go around it through the fixo, then switch wide.
choiceExplanations: Right. Pull the block one way, go around it through the fixo, then switch wide.
First the block must shift. Then the pass behind the press takes us around it.
The fixo switches only after getting the ball behind the press.
The right ala receives last, outside the narrow block.

questions.q: Now the block has shifted right. The fixo has the ball. Which pass completes the switch?
options: Pass across to the left ala
questions.explain: Yes. The far defender is still narrow, so the left ala is free outside the block.
choiceExplanations: The block moved to that side. A defender is right on the right ala.
Yes. The far defender is still narrow, so the left ala is free outside the block.
A defender stands in the middle lane. The compact block closes the pivot.
